topic: the Jev v2 operations-controller architecture as a deployable skill: gated-approval orchestration (understand, decide, deterministic fail-closed gate, execute, verify, terminal states, human review, append-only audit) for autonomous agents

subtopics.scope: The seven-stage operations controller flow (ingest, understand, decide, gate, execute, verify, terminal) and why stage ordering, not model intelligence, is what makes an autonomous agent trustworthy.
seed_queries: LLM agent orchestration pipeline stages understand decide execute verify
agent action pipeline approval gate plan verify execute pattern

subtopics.scope: The deterministic fail-closed policy gate: versioned policy, stamped enforcement version, deny-by-default semantics, and re-gating each action immediately before dispatch.
seed_queries: fail closed deny by default policy engine authorization security
policy gate authorization tool calls autonomous agents versioned policy

subtopics.scope: The human approval loop: approval bindings (actor, target, payload hash, limits, expiry, policy version), the review queue, and binding-mismatch failure classes.
seed_queries: human in the loop approval workflow autonomous AI agent actions
approval binding payload hash expiry human review agent dispatch

subtopics.scope: Terminal states and failure paths: a closed terminal enum, retry-within-limits, reconciliation, honest close, and reporting partial completion truthfully.
seed_queries: workflow state machine terminal states idempotency retry reconciliation
autonomous agent task failure retry limits honest reporting design

subtopics.scope: Append-only central state and audit: event-chained tables, why mutable state is forbidden, and the pause/kill switch that cannot undo effects already executed.
seed_queries: append only audit log tamper evident event chain design
durable execution audit trail immutable event log workflow engine

subtopics.scope: The advisory decision layer: typed decision models (intent category, actionable yes/no, risk score, proposed action) that inform the pipeline but never authorize dispatch themselves.
seed_queries: calibrated decision model classifier agent workflow routing probabilities
LLM structured output decision gate never authorize action advisory

subtopics.scope: The improve loop with guardrails: learnings recorded as data that cannot activate themselves, and how self-improvement is kept inside the same gated pipeline.
seed_queries: bounded recursive self improvement agent loop guardrails
agent learning loop prevent self activation human approval

subtopics.scope: Building the controller with parallel implementation lanes: capability map, deps-injected modules with self-contained tests, and the cross-lane bug classes integrators must hunt (async thenable dedupe, unawaited hashing, sync config loads).
seed_queries: parallel subagent lanes modular build dependency injected modules
integration phase cross module bugs async race promise thenable test suites

subtopics.scope: Deploying the controller onto a live worker without shadowing existing routes, a versioned policy starter, the first gated end-to-end run, and the open items it surfaced (scoped executor credentials).
seed_queries: Cloudflare Workers add new routes without breaking existing routes deploy
first production run lessons agent orchestration rate limits credentials
